title: A work order keeps its tier after the customer moves to another tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  4. Type 1 in Qty.
  5. Pick category A in Category.
  6. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  9. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
  10. Open the Work Order Tier picker.
  11. Pick tier B.
  12. Click Save.
  13. Open work order 1.
  14. Click Add Part under line 1.
  15. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  16. Type 1 in Qty.
  17. Pick category A in Category.
  18. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  19. Click Save.
  20. Create a new work order, work order 2, for customer A with one labor line.
  21. Click Add Part under line 1.
  22. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  23. Type 1 in Qty.
  24. Pick category A in Category.
  25. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  26. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 4:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 5:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 6:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 7:

  • The part fills in at $121.50 ($135.00 × 0.90 = $121.50).

Step 8:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 9:

  • Edit Customer opens.

Step 10:

  • The picker lists tier B.

Step 11:

  • Work Order Tier reads tier B.

Step 12:

  • Customer A is saved on tier B.

Step 13:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 14:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 15:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 16:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 17:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 18:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 19:

  • The new part on work order 1 fills in at $121.50, still tier A's price.

Step 20:

  • Work order 2 opens.

Step 21:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 22:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 23:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 24:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 25:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 26:

  • The part on work order 2 fills in at $108.00, tier B's price: $135.00 less 20% = $108.00.
